✅ About Our Brand & Products

Nailsami is a premium nail brand dedicated to delivering high-quality, salon-grade nail products for professionals and at-home users. We focus on safe, long-lasting, and trend-forward formulas designed to help customers achieve beautiful, healthy nails with ease.

Our product range includes carefully curated gel polishes, nail essentials, and professional tools, developed with performance, quality, and style in mind.

✅ What Makes Us Different

  • ✨ Salon-quality products at accessible prices

  • 🌱 Carefully selected ingredients and strict quality control

  • 💅 Long-lasting, high-pigment, easy-to-apply formulas

  • 📦 Reliable international shipping

  • 🤝 Strong support for creators and partners

  • 🚫 No low-quality mass-market sourcing

We focus on building a trusted, long-term brand — not short-term sales.

✅ How Affiliates Can Earn

  • Earn commission on every successful order through your link or code

  • Trackable affiliate links and exclusive discount codes

  • Competitive cookie duration

  • Performance-based bonuses for top partners

  • Opportunity to become a long-term brand ambassador

You earn when your audience shops with us — simple and transparent.

✅ How to Promote Us

Affiliates are welcome to promote Nailsami through:

  • 📱 Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and social media

  • 🎥 Product reviews, tutorials, and nail art content

  • 📸 Before & after photos

  • 🛍️ Hauls and unboxings

  • 🎁 Giveaways and special campaigns (with approval)

We encourage authentic, creative content that reflects your real experience with our products.

✅ Other Information

  • Approved promotional methods only (no spam or misleading ads)

  • No unauthorized coupon sites or browser extensions

  • Dedicated affiliate support team

  • We value long-term, trust-based partnerships

  • Regular performance reviews and growth opportunities

We reserve the right to review affiliate activities to protect our brand and community.
